headline: Referred 30 Beecher Street tax request and $22,312.67 and $152,458.08 abatements to Finance Committee; approved Rice Street signs.
summary: Six RI Energy requests to install or move utility poles were approved, pending Public Works approval. Two pothole damage claims were approved, and a $1,349.08 tire damage claim was denied and referred to JR Vinagro Construction Corporation. The Elisha Project lease was referred to two committees, and Michael William Cooper was confirmed to the Juvenile Hearing Board.
decisions: Approved the October 21, 2026 City Property Committee and City Council meeting records.
Approved the consent agenda by unanimous voice vote.
Referred a communication about the Elisha Project lease to the City Property and Ordinance committees.
Referred the Piccadilly LLC tax stabilization agreement request for 30 Beecher Street to the Finance Committee.
Referred a $22,312.67 tax abatement resolution for April through June 2026 to the Finance Committee.
Referred a $152,458.08 tax abatement resolution for July through September 2026 to the Finance Committee.
Passed requests asking Public Works for stop signs, speed limit signs, and a crosswalk update on Rice Street by unanimous voice vote.
Passed a request for a copy of a Roosevelt Avenue traffic study and questions on two intersections by unanimous voice vote.
Approved six RI Energy pole petitions, pending approval from the Director of Public Works.
Confirmed Michael William Cooper to the Juvenile Hearing Board, 6-0.
Approved pothole damage claims for Napoleon Gonsalves ($275.00) and Nicholas Jensen ($300.00), 6-0.
Denied Pericles Vieira's $1,349.08 tire damage claim and referred it to JR Vinagro Construction Corporation, 6-0.
